svg.title: One readout moves the estimate
svg.desc: Three small plots of the estimator's distribution over T1, with its estimate marked: before any shot, 150 microseconds; after reading 1 at 50 µs, 163 microseconds; after reading 0 at 50 µs, 128 microseconds. A qubit still excited after the wait pushes the estimate up, one that decayed pulls it down.
